title: Verified media location
responsibility: Names intact capture bytes by content hash and reports a gap when bytes are absent or differ from the record.

inputs.name: mediaPlace.bytes
inputs.description: Original capture bytes, or undefined when unavailable.

inputs.name: mediaPlace.file
inputs.description: Recorded path and expected SHA-256 digest; the path supplies the extension.

inputs.name: mediaPlace.gap
inputs.description: Explanation to return when bytes are missing or fail the digest check.

outputs.name: mediaPlace
outputs.description: media/hash.extension when bytes match, using a lowercase extension or bin fallback; otherwise media null and the supplied gap. No file is read or written.

outputs.name: checkedMedia
outputs.description: Async MediaPlacer wrapper around the same check; it reports placement without writing bytes.
